utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s still this Saturday at Opal’s front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you can spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll spread the word and can help for a bit on Saturday if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Leo — that would be a huge help. I’ll keep you posted on the timing and what we need you to do.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking now—if we’re short, can you help me gather more gloves, tape, and flashlights for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with that—just let me know what you still need most. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m glad to get the latest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — gloves are the biggest gap right now, then tape, and we’re okay on flashlights for the moment.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word—we still could use a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll do what I can to help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli—much appreciated. I’ll keep letting folks know about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep you posted, and I appreciate you being ready to help on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Rosa — just let me know what you need once it’s all set, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Sam — I’m lining everything up now and I’ll send you the task list as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at my front porch, and I could use help with sorting donations and setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help with setup. What time should I come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — please come by at 10 a.m. at my front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re set for the front porch this Saturday, and I could still use a few helpers for setup and sorting repairs. If you know anyone else free, please spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with setup and sorting repairs on Saturday. I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be awesome, Rey — thanks! I’ll keep spreading the word too, and I’ll see you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Oren — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use more helpers. If you can help point people to sorting donations and setup, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help point folks to sorting donations and with setup on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Oren — that’s a big help. Please send folks to sorting donations first, then setup at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most from me, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes—just confirming, it’s still this Saturday on the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right—this Saturday on the front porch. I’m still happy to help, so just tell me if you need me to sort tools or load up anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — and just a heads-up, the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. Send me the final list when you have it, and I’ll dig around for the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll send the final list once I check it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Noah — thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for that final list and see what tools I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — Saturday at 10 on the front porch works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the updated details soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for the updated details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — that’d help a lot. I still need a few helpers for Saturday, especially if you can spread the word about the porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, small update — it’s actually moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’m sorry for the mix-up, but I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for letting me know — Sunday at the community center works better. I still need a few helpers, so please keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re still looking for a few drills, screwdrivers, and maybe a ladder, and it’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Sunday at the community center. I can see if I’ve got a drill or screwdriver to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Bo—every bit helps. If you find a ladder too, bring it along to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — yes, please bring the wrench set and screwdrivers if you can. We’re still gathering helpers for Saturday at the front porch, so any extra hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can bring the wrench set and screwdrivers and help out on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Sam — if you can start with the porch lights and then check the loose boards, that’d be perfect. I’ll keep rounding up a few more helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — if you can send a few more helpers my way, I’d appreciate it. Sorting donations and setup at the front porch are still the main things I need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll see who I can round up for sorting donations and setup at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — that would help a lot. I’ll be at the front porch this Saturday if anyone needs directions or wants to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center now. I can still help coordinate around the school schedule if needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center should be easier, but I’m a little worried about the logistics. If you can help around the school schedule, that would be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll work around the school schedule and help keep things lined up for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on that repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll send over the drop-off details as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll wait for the drop-off details and can help if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s coming together—do you still need anyone to do the small repairs or just help at the front porch Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Both, if you’re up for it—I still need a few people for small repairs and some help at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I can help with both—just let me know where to start on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive is this Saturday at the front porch, and I’d love any extra help spreading the word. If you hear anyone interested, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, got it — I’ll pass it along, but I think it’s actually moved to Sunday at the community center. Send me any details and I’ll share them when I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, thanks for the heads-up — I’ll double-check the final details and let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center if that’s the update. Appreciate you spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll send the final list if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Uli. Let me know if you need anything else for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate it — I’ll let you know if anything else comes up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the community center on Sunday and check in with Lena or Omar if I get there late.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — if you see Lena or Omar, they’ll know where to point you. We could still use a few more drills, screwdrivers, and maybe a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for those and bring what I can. If I’m late, I’ll just check with Lena or Omar at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, it’s now on Sunday at the community center. That’s the latest update on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works. Do we still have enough gloves, tape, and flashlights to get it started?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m not sure we’ve confirmed that yet, but I can ask around and let you know. The main update is still Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I can help with the repair drive Saturday at 10 on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what kinds of repairs should I expect people to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d expect small household fixes like loose knobs, squeaky hinges, and minor patch-ups — nothing major. If you want, I can help sort the items when people arrive.
